disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SEM concentrations of Cu, Mn, Pb, Ni, Cd and Cr in seven market vegetables and banana from Gwagwalada market.

study.design: Cross-sectional market survey with health risk assessment
study.market: Gwagwalada Central Market, Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, Nigeria
study.method: Nitric acid digestion (2 g, 80 C); graphite furnace AAS for Cd, Cr, Ni, Pb; air-acetylene flame AAS (Thermo iCE 3000) for Cu and Mn
study.lod_text: Cd 0.002 µg/L, Cr 0.004 µg/L, Ni 0.07 µg/L, Pb 0.05 µg/L (instrument, in solution); Cu and Mn 0.0015 µg/L
study.qa: Blanks and QC standards every five samples; procedural blanks <5% of mean analyte concentrations; replicate analysis of standard reference materials within ±2% of certified values (CRM not named)
